# ERC-7730 coverage skill

An agent skill for writing ERC-7730 v2 calldata descriptors for the most-used uncovered contracts on Ethereum mainnet and opening one draft PR per protocol in https://github.com/ethereum/clear-signing-erc7730-registry.

Full instructions: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/portdeveloper/clear-signing-helper/main/SKILL.md

In short:

1. Pick contracts from https://erc7730.sourcify.dev/api/live/ranking?window=24h&limit=25&offset=0&exclude=eth,token,unverified,infra. Skip those already covered, in someone's open PR, needing custom encoding, with unverified code, paused, bot-only, or short-lived (ask the user for the last).
2. Read the verified source of every function you describe. The screen must be true for any argument value; pin switches with mustMatch.
3. Sentence names every amount (including {@.value}) and the recipient. Intent at most 30 characters, labels at most 20.
4. Tests use real transactions with txHash; expected text comes from the runners, never by hand.
5. Run the registry's linter and both test runners at the registry's pins. 0 errors, every case passes in both.
6. Open a draft PR that says the descriptor is not from the contract's owner. Do not open it without the user's word.

Contracts already looked at (2026-11-10): https://github.com/portdeveloper/clear-signing-helper/blob/main/ADDRESSED-CONTRACTS.md
